story.title: From Humble Beginnings to Industry Leader
story.subtitle: Founded in 2009, Fal Parts started as a small family business with a big vision: to revolutionize the automotive parts industry in the Middle East.

milestone1.title: 2009 - Foundation
milestone1.desc: Started as a small shop in Riyadh with a vision to provide quality automotive parts.

milestone2.title: 2015 - Expansion
milestone2.desc: Expanded to 10 locations across Saudi Arabia and launched our e-commerce platform.

milestone3.title: 2020 - Innovation
milestone3.desc: Launched AI-powered parts matching and 24/7 customer support system.

milestone4.title: 2024 - Global Reach
milestone4.desc: Serving customers in 25+ countries with cutting-edge technology and unmatched service.
